objective: Qualify that long-form literary interpretations remain coupled to exact localized evidence, including middle-book factual and temporal support, without treating short-passage or macro-only success as proof of whole-book accuracy.
qualification_scope: Independent synthetic/support fixtures only. This boundary does not score, tune against, or reveal LGT-001..006, author labels, private manuscript prose, or protected blind-evaluator ground truth.

required_layers.macro_interpretation: Each gold macro claim has a stable claim_id and claim_code; an asserted prediction must match the claim code rather than receiving credit merely for fluent analysis.
required_layers.exact_evidence_linkage: Every asserted claim references exact anchor IDs whose locator_id, SHA256 digest, and chapter index match the held-out support fixture.
required_layers.long_range_support: A claim marked long_range must be supported by exact anchors spanning at least two chapters.
required_layers.temporal_linkage: Temporal relations preserve earlier/later event identity and are linked to exact anchors that ground both referenced events.
required_layers.middle_book_support: When required, the middle-third slice must contain at least one exactly linked factual claim and one exactly linked temporal relation touching a middle-book anchor.

admission_rules: Macro correctness and evidence-linkage correctness are reported separately and both must pass for PASS_LINKED.
Exact evidence linkage requires anchor identity plus locator_id plus SHA256 plus chapter index; a well-formed but wrong locator or digest receives no linkage credit.
Long-range macro claims cannot pass on single-chapter evidence.
Middle-book support cannot be inferred from beginning/end anchors; required factual and temporal support must touch the computed middle third of the work.
Unsupported asserted macro claims fail closed.
Unknown claim or temporal anchor references fail closed.
ABSTAIN and UNRESOLVED remain valid non-authoritative outcomes and are never converted into manufactured support.
Raw manuscript, passage, candidate, quote, or source-excerpt payloads are forbidden in qualification records.
A passing support slice establishes linkage-contract integrity only; it does not establish whole-book literary accuracy, author intent, revision authority, canon authority, or publication authority.
